objections.claim: The adapter claims to wrap a pinned Anima donor but will silently import any installed package exposing anima.store, so local or future runs can produce evidence against the wrong donor revision.
objections.evidence: AnimaMemoryAdapter.open imports anima.store by module name and performs no source-byte or revision verification. CI pins the checkout, but the adapter itself does not protect provenance outside CI.
objections.disposition: Verify the imported donor source against the known Git blob identity for anima/store.py at the pinned revision, and test the verification boundary.

objections.claim: The donor registry says the MemoryStore decision is adapt even though this experiment deliberately preserves the donor implementation and wraps it behind an adapter.
objections.evidence: donors/registry.json lists anima-always-awake/memory-store with decision adapt; the experiment documentation and implementation state that MemoryStore is unmodified.
objections.disposition: Change the component decision to wrap and record the new harness evidence without promoting the entire donor to accepted status.

objections.claim: A passing matched-history result cannot be attributed to Anima's strength increment alone because recall simultaneously updates recency, access_count, and strength.
objections.evidence: The donor recall path updates last_access_ts and access_count and adds strength, while later decay uses last_access_ts, access_count, importance, and strength.
objections.disposition: Keep the claim at the composite level, retrieval-history-dependent durability, and explicitly forbid interpreting this experiment as an isolation of the testing-effect strength term.
